title: Adding a Spouse, Child, School Child or Parent to a Disability Compensation Award
content:
**Payability.** Additional compensation for dependents is payable only when the tier in effect on the award is one at which additional amounts for dependents are payable — Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating). The tier is read from the award record; at Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) and Disability Compensation (20% Combined Rating) no dependent is added.

**Written claim.** A spouse, child, school child or dependent parent is added only on a dependency claim received online or by mail; a telephone report cannot add a dependent. The dependency claim behind an addition is the claim record on file, with its channel; a caller's description of the family over the telephone is not a dependency claim.

**School children.** A school child is added only on a school-attendance claim showing enrollment at an approved school, from the school-child minimum-age birthday (or the term start, if later) until the day before the school-child age-limit birthday.

**Parents.** No more than the parent maximum of parents are recognized.

**Effective date.** The addition is effective on the date of the marriage, birth or adoption when the dependency claim is received within the dependency report window in calendar days after that event, and on the date the claim was received otherwise.

**Retired clause.** The clause under which the first entitlement month paid at the higher rate was the month after the effective date is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Past-due additions.** Past-due dependent additions for months already paid at the lower rate are released as a retroactive payment.

**Conditions for an addition at a glance**

| Condition | Met when |
|---|---|
| Tier allows dependent amounts | The award carries a tier from 30 percent to 100 percent |
| Written channel | The dependency claim on file was received online or by mail |
| School child | A school-attendance claim shows enrollment at an approved school and the child is within the school-child ages |
| Parent count | Recognizing the parent does not take the award beyond the parent maximum |

**Effective-date cases (hypothetical, with the 365-day dependency report window).**
- Birth on 5 June 2025, dependency claim received 5 June 2026 (365 days after): effective 5 June 2025.
- Birth on 5 June 2025, dependency claim received 6 June 2026 (366 days after): effective 6 June 2026, the date the claim was received.

superseded_clauses: the first entitlement month paid at the higher rate is the month after the effective date
